node.title: XR deficient window: two-block kernel-slack router
node.statement: Put r=h-d and sigma=d-ell-1-2r. Every nonempty D-local deficient target has 2r<=|D|<=|G_d|<=2r+sigma. If sigma<r, it has exactly two selected live blocks, those blocks cover all but sigma points of both D and G_d, and every kernel multiplier is the G_d locator times a polynomial of degree below sigma+1. At the tuple-incidence obstruction sigma is exactly 5,5,1 on the three official rows, so the deficient residue has cofactor degree below 6,6,2 and is structurally stronger than a generic nullity-at-most-six window.
